after_matching.explanation: Bony-fish reporting scope is verified for exact SAU key 100039 (ISSCAAP 39; FAO Osteichthyes), rather than inferred from the English label. Represented bony fish groups 14–42 form the broad composition proxy; dedicated shark, ray/skate and torpedo pools 13 and 43–47 are excluded. Mixed NC large pelagic 14 remains eligible through source-listed Mola mola; Cetorhinus maximus and Mobula mobular are outside target scope, so full pooled source quantities retain an unobserved-composition mismatch. Residual taxonomic composition, unrepresented taxa and wider-region transfer remain unobserved; membership and overall confidence remain Very low. Incomplete source landings. Complete accepted model biomass provides an explicitly assumed composition proxy, not observed caught mass. Fixed proportions are transferred across 1950–2019 years and all catch bases; no missing candidate is discarded.
